user_story: As a user, I want to be able to add and remove elements dynamically on the page so that I can test the functionality of adding and removing elements as needed.
cypress_script: describe('Add and Remove Elements', () => { it('should add an element when the button is clicked', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/'); cy.get('button').contains('Add Element').click(); cy.get('#elements').children().should('have.length', 1); }); it('should remove an element when the remove button is clicked', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/'); cy.get('button').contains('Add Element').click(); cy.get('#elements').children().should('have.length', 1); cy.get('#elements').children().first().click(); cy.get('#elements').children().should('have.length', 0); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Add and Remove Elements', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/'); await page.click('button:has-text("Add Element")'); const elements = await page.locator('#elements').locator('div').count(); expect(elements).toBe(1); await page.click('#elements div'); const elementsAfterRemoval = await page.locator('#elements').locator('div').count(); expect(elementsAfterRemoval).toBe(0); });
